turns.learner: Hi, can we practise articles a, an and the? Please give me an exercise.
turns.tutor:
Here is the first one. Write only the missing word.

Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)

"an" is correct. Here is a fresh one for you to do on your own.

Write a or an: My uncle is ___ doctor. (answer with only the missing word)

Yes, "a" is correct: doctor starts with a consonant sound. Now a different point, on your own.

Write a, an or the: I bought a book. ___ book is very good. (answer with only the missing word)
